title_sq: Tek Mei's Garden, Shiten 4 Poste Parkimi, Ideal Per Investim!!!
description_sq: Tek Mei's Garden, Shiten 4 Poste Parkimi, Ideal Per Investim!!! Disponojme 4 poste ne katin -2 me siperfaqe totale prej 36.67 m2, nga ku siperfaqja neto eshte 15 m2. Postet e parkimit jane te vendosura njeri pas tjetrit dhe jane nje mundesi ideale per investim. Gjithashtu shiten edhe te ndare, ku vlera per secilin post eshte 17.500 euro. Residenca Mei's Garden eshte objekt banimi 6-11 kate me 2 kate parkim nentoke dhe dallohet per punimet teper cilesore duke filluar nga instalimet hidraulike-elektrike, fasade te ventiluar, shtrimi me pllake ose parket sipas deshires se klientit, dritaret dopioxham termike te pajisura me grila, hapesira pushimi dhe hapesira te gjelberta perreth kompleksit.
title_en: At Mei's Garden, 4 parking spaces are for sale, ideal for investment!!!
description_en: At Mei's Garden, 4 parking spaces are for sale, ideal for investment!!! We have 4 offices on the -2nd floor with a total area of ​​36.67 m2, of which the net area is 15 m2. The parking posts are located one after the other and are an ideal opportunity for investment. They are also sold separately, where the value for each post is 17,500 euros. Residence Mei's Garden is a residential building of 6-11 floors with 2 floors of underground parking and stands out for its high-quality works, starting from hydraulic-electrical installations, ventilated facades, paving with tiles or parquet according to the customer's wishes, thermal double-glazed windows equipped with shutters, rest spaces and green spaces around the complex.
